name: DUT Serial Number Reader
description: Acquires and validates DUT serial number via Serial Port (barcode scanner / UART) or CSV file.
help_text: Acquires the DUT serial number from a Serial Port (barcode scanner or DUT UART response) or a sequential CSV file, and injects it into the test sequence and trace reports.

criteria_help.source_mode: Method to obtain serial number: Serial Port (barcode scanner or DUT UART query) or Sequential CSV file.
criteria_help.scan_timeout_sec: Maximum time in seconds to wait for scanner input or UART response on the serial port.
criteria_help.dut_query_cmd: UART query command sent to DUT (e.g. AT+HWID?\r\n). Leave empty for barcode scanners that transmit upon scanning.
criteria_help.csv_file_path: Path to CSV file containing serial numbers.
criteria_help.csv_column_index: 0-based column index in CSV file containing the serial numbers.
criteria_help.min_length: Minimum required character length for valid serial numbers.
criteria_help.prefix_filter: Required prefix that serial numbers must start with (e.g. 'SN-').
criteria_help.regex_pattern: Regular expression pattern for format validation.
